purpose: Trigger behavior spec. CI checks lexical routing from these cases; behavioral expectations live in evals.json.

cases.prompt: translate this PDF document while preserving original visual layout and typography
cases.assert: Triggers pdf-translate to inspect physical dimensions, extract translation contracts, and render publication-grade vector PDF.

cases.prompt: translate this PDF to Chinese while keeping the original formatting and tables
cases.assert: Uses pdf-translate two-stage translation and HTML print paged media reconstruction.

cases.prompt: audit translated PDF geometry and layout against the source document
cases.assert: Invokes the automated 1:1 audit engine to compare page counts, vector layers, and clause alignment.

cases.prompt: translate this short plain text paragraph into French
cases.assert: Does not trigger because the user requested quick plain text translation without PDF layout preservation.

cases.prompt: compress this PDF file to make the file size smaller
cases.assert: Does not trigger because PDF compression is outside the translation scope.

cases.prompt: split this multi-page PDF into separate single page files
cases.assert: Does not trigger because PDF splitting is a file utility operation, not translation.
